english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), the defendant

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale; and Note: If the contravention / failure is continued after conviction, to a further fine not exceeding £40 for every day on which the contravention or failure is so continued.

Time limit for prosecution:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
